title: WWII Remains Found in Danube River
summary: The low water levels in the Danube river have revealed the remains of WWII soldiers and a well-preserved motorcycle. The bodies of two Wehrmacht soldiers were found, with one having served in the Waffen-SS. Identification tags were also discovered alongside the bodies. The motorcycle, which belonged to the Wehrmacht, was found to be in remarkably good condition. The discovery was made possible due to the low water levels in the river.
summary_points: Remains of two Wehrmacht soldiers found in the Danube river
One soldier served in the Waffen-SS
A well-preserved Wehrmacht motorcycle was discovered
Identification tags were found alongside the bodies
Low water levels in the Danube river led to the discovery
